Hi

To any Prisma 3d users having issues when you initially import him as to why his arms and head are very blue? It’s because of the blue outline he has. I suppose it didn’t cull it properly but to those Prisma 3d users wanting to remove it:

Hey, I figured out something… I found out that you can still keep the outline for both Finn & Poppy in Prisma 3d. Keep in mind (again) that this is for Prisma 3d users.

To do this, you must go into faces mode, double tap on the parts that have an outline (e.g. poppy’s head, Finn’s head, their arms, etc) but do NOT box select it as box select will select anything including on the base model itself (idk how to explain it but you’ll figure it out). Afterwards, DETACH the selected faces and use the scale tool to essentially “Reverse” the outline (basically just flip it around). Afterwards, make a separate material texture for that outline and set the culling mode from AUTO to INSIDE and bam, you got your Finn & Poppy models but they still have their ingame outlines.
